AI Data Analysis Tools

Julius AI

Julius AI lets users analyze files and connected data sources by asking questions in natural language and receiving code-backed analysis, charts and exports.

What is Julius AI?

Julius AI is an AI data workspace that turns natural-language requests into structured analytical work. Users can upload common file formats or connect live data, ask for calculations and statistical analysis, generate visualizations, work with generated Python or other supported code and export results for continued use.

Best for: Analysts, researchers, students and business users who need exploratory analysis and visualization without writing every query or script manually.

Main features

  • Natural-language data analysis
  • CSV, Excel, JSON, PDF and image uploads
  • Database and warehouse connectors
  • Chart and visualization generation
  • Code-backed statistical analysis
  • CSV and Excel export
  • Shared workspaces and notebooks

Use cases

  • Explore a spreadsheet by asking questions in plain language
  • Create charts from uploaded business data
  • Run statistical analyses and calculations
  • Clean or transform tabular data
  • Export analyzed data to CSV or Excel

Who is it for?

  • business analysts
  • researchers
  • students
  • data analysts
  • data scientists

Pricing and plans

freemium subscription with credit-based usage

Starting price: USD 20 / month for Plus on monthly billing

Advantages

  • Low barrier to entry for common analytical workflows
  • Can show and execute code-backed analysis rather than only returning prose
  • Supports both uploaded files and connected data sources

Limitations

  • Usage is metered through credits on paid plans
  • More advanced database, team and agent capabilities are concentrated in higher tiers
  • AI-generated statistical results still require human validation for important decisions

Frequently asked questions

What file types can Julius analyze?

Julius documents support for formats including CSV, Excel, JSON, PDF and images, and it can also connect to databases and warehouses.

Can Julius create charts and export results?

Yes. It can generate common visualizations and export resulting data to CSV or Excel.

Does Julius have a verified public developer API?

A general public API was not confirmed in the official pages checked for this pass, so API availability is marked unknown rather than inferred.
